description: A partial render of a source that changes colour part way through, which pins seeking to the exact frame. The source is one second of red then one second of green at 30fps, so source frame 29 is the last red and 30 the first green. The clip opens 5 frames in and the range skips a further 20, so the render should start at source frame 25: output frames 0-4 are red and 5-9 are green. Losing the clip's own source_in, losing the range's offset, or adding them wrong all move that boundary and fail here.
